SUMMARY OF ABBREVIATIONS
G6PD Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase
LPS Lipopolysaccharide
MDR-TB Multidrug Resistant Tuberculosis
MIC Minimum Inhibitory Concentration
PAE Post-Antibiotic Effect
TB Tuberculosis
LEARNING OBJECTIVES
✔ To define the terminology related to antimicrobial therapy.
✔ To discuss the principles involved in the rational choice
of antimicrobials.
I. INTRODUCTION
● The oldest and most famous book on war is the “Art of
War” by Sun Tzu.
→ Applies to our battle against infectious diseases.
II. DEFINITION OF TERMS
A. ANTIBIOTICS
● Derived from two Greek words: “anti” - against; “bios” - life
● Substances produced by one microorganism that kill or
prevent the growth of another microorganism
B. CHEMOTHERAPY
● Antimicrobial chemotherapy
● The use of synthetic chemicals to destroy infective
agents
